name: Light We Make
source:
A peaceful stroll through the forest can turn into a nightmare. You are on a dangerous quest. Stay alert and heed your companion… survival is uncertain.

[From [url=https://bdblaffy.itch.io/light-we-make]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
林間一場安靜的散步，也可能變成惡夢。你正在執行一項危險的任務。保持警惕，聽從同伴的提醒……能否活下來，還很難說。
